description: LV Monitoring Aggregated Data is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " LV Monitoring Aggregated " data table provides a summary of the capacity utilisation of secondary substations with LV monitoring coverage on a monthly aggregated level in the SPEN SPD and SPM licence areas. An additional.gpkg file is uploaded to provide mapping to the geopoints of each secondary substation location. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are LV Monitors, LV, Capacity, Utilisation, Secondary Visibility. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
